title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 12: the prophet's baggage carried out through the wall, the sign for the prince, and the end of the proverb about delayed visions.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say about the eyes and ears of the rebellious house?
questions.explanation: They have eyes to see and don't see, and ears to hear and don't hear, for they are a rebellious house.

answers.text: They have eyes to see but do not see
They see visions and dream dreams
They hear the word gladly and obey
They were born blind and deaf

questions.text: What was the prophet told to prepare and move in their sight?
questions.explanation: He was told to prepare his stuff for moving and to move by day from his place to another place in their sight.

answers.text: A wall around his house
An altar of stones
His stuff for moving
A scroll to be read aloud

questions.text: What was he told to do to the wall?
questions.explanation: He was told to dig through the wall in their sight and carry his stuff out that way.

answers.text: Plaster it with whitewash
Dig through it
Measure it with a line
Build it up higher

questions.text: Why was he to cover his face as he carried his things out?
questions.explanation: He was to cover his face so that he would not see the land, for Yahweh had set him as a sign to the house of Israel.

answers.text: So that no one would recognize him
To mourn for those who had died
To hide himself from the sword
So that he would not see the land

questions.explanation: Yahweh says the burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem and all the house of Israel among whom they are.

answers.text: The prince in Jerusalem
The priests of the temple
The king of Babylon
The elders among the captives

questions.text: Where would the one caught in Yahweh's snare be brought?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will spread his net on him and bring him to Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans, which he will not see although he will die there.

answers.text: To Egypt, to the house of Pharaoh
To Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans
To Assyria, to its cities
Into the wilderness of the peoples

questions.text: Why would Yahweh leave a few men alive from the sword, famine and pestilence?
questions.explanation: He would leave a few of them so that they might declare all their abominations among the nations where they come.

answers.text: So that they would rebuild Jerusalem
So that they would carry back the temple vessels
So that they would declare their abominations among the nations
So that they would rule over the Chaldeans

questions.text: How was the prophet told to eat his bread and drink his water?
questions.explanation: He was told to eat his bread with quaking and to drink his water with trembling and with fearfulness.

answers.text: With singing and gladness
In haste, standing up
With bitter herbs
With quaking and trembling

questions.text: What proverb did the people have in the land of Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asks about the proverb, 'The days are prolonged, and every vision fails,' and says he will make it cease.

answers.text: As is the mother, so is her daughter
The days are prolonged, and every vision fails
The fathers have eaten sour grapes
A sword, a sword, it is sharpened

questions.text: What answer does Yahweh give to those who say his visions are for times far off?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says none of his words will be deferred any more, but the word which he speaks will be performed.

answers.text: None of his words will be deferred any more
The vision is only for the exiles
The vision concerns Egypt alone
He will send them another prophet
